title: Confit de Canard
description: A traditional method for duck confit, with curing and slow cooking immersed in duck fat; maintain safe refrigeration.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 720 minutes.
Submerge the cured, rinsed duck legs in duck fat and cook gently at 110–120°C for about 2¾ hours until the meat is very tender; do not boil the fat.
Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 12 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
